content: {"rules": ["The model exhibits a persistent upward bias, consistently overestimating prices during the initial 10-day horizon of the forecast window.", "Forecasts fail to capture the magnitude of the sharp downward trend (mean reversion) observed in the true data, resulting in a significant lag where the model predicts stabilization while prices continue to fall.", "Positive sentiment signals (1.00) in the history do not trigger corresponding upward adjustments in the forecast, indicating the model underweights bullish sentiment during volatile periods.", "The model incorrectly assumes a recovery or stabilization after the price drop, whereas the true outcome shows a delayed but sharp rebound that the model misses entirely in the mid-to-late forecast horizon.", "Correction heuristic: Apply a downward adjustment of 3-5 EUR to the first 10 days of the forecast when recent history shows a declining trend, and delay the predicted recovery phase by at least 10 days."]}
